summary: Implemented the Tabs feature without running tests or repository code, and without committing. Changes: new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (Tab, TabsRenderable, Tabs); UnderlineBar gained clickable_ranges (before width) and now yields one rich Text; Opacity now merges blended color into the existing style so meta is kept. The layout resolver needed no change because Edge already has size, min_size=1, and fraction=1. Added tests in tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py (appended), tests/widgets/test_tabs.py, and tests/widgets/__init__.py; docs/reference/tabs.md; and an optional sandbox/tabs_demo.py with tabs_demo.css. Decisions to review: the bar position uses the displayed-tab index rather than the full-list find_tab_by_name index, so underlines stay correct when a duplicate name precedes the active one; Escape calls app.focus only if it exists, since App has no focus method here; letter search only handles single-character keys; a zero-width label gets a flexible share. Nothing has been verified by execution.
